title: Hierarchical Skill Retrieval for Data-Efficient Adaptation of Vision-Language-Action Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.24042v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: While Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models pretrained on large-scale robot datasets provide a strong foundation for robot manipulation, their performance can degrade when adapted to new tasks with limited task-specific demonstrations. Retrieval offers a practical way to reuse existing demonstrations for data-efficient adaptation, but existing methods often rely on visual similarity, state-action representations, or task-level language matching. These approaches may overlook the hierarchical structure of long-horizon manipulation tasks, where complete task matches are rare but reusable skills are often abundant. To address this challenge, we propose Hierarchical Skill Retrieval (HSR), a retrieval framework for data-efficient VLA adaptation. translated_title: 面向视觉-语言-动作模型数据高效适应的层次化技能检索
translated_abstract: 尽管在大规模机器人数据集上预训练的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型为机器人操作提供了坚实基础，但当适应到具有有限任务特定演示的新任务时，其性能可能会下降。检索提供了一种重用现有演示以实现数据高效适应的实用方法，但现有方法通常依赖于视觉相似性、状态-动作表示或任务级语言匹配。这些方法可能忽视长时程操作任务的层次化结构，其中完整任务匹配罕见，但可重用技能往往丰富。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了层次化技能检索（HSR），一种用于数据高效VLA适应的检索框架。具体而言，HSR首先将目标任务分解为候选技能序列。它基于语义合理性和从先验数据集估计的技能可靠性来评估每个计划。该
tldr: 本文提出了一种层次化技能检索框架，通过将长时程任务分解为技能序列并基于语义和可靠性评估，实现了数据高效的视觉-语言-动作模型适应。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a hierarchical skill retrieval framework that decomposes long-horizon tasks into skill sequences and evaluates them based on semantics and reliability, enabling data-efficient adaptation of vision-language-action models.
